title: Microsoft’s first Windows 11 update of 2026 stopped some computers from shuting down
summary: Microsoft released its first security update of 2026 for Windows 11 on January 13th. Just four days later, it was forced to release an emergency out-of-band update to fix some pretty serious bugs, the first one introduced.
